    V

    valoresSocio(Scanner) - Method in class Gym
    This method asks for the identification number of the member and goes to fetch that member in the list of sociosIndividuais in case it's an Individual member otherwise it look at the list of sociosEmpresarios.
    In Case of the number not existing in either of theses lists it will send a message.
    If found, it aggregates all associated bookings to compute: Total amount spent (sum of discounted final costs) Total amount saved (difference between base prices and final costs) Total number of bookings made Results are printed in a formatted summary including the member's name and ID.
